releases.new: Use PEP 832 .venv redirect files for project environments, and opt into a preview feature that closes unresponsive HTTP/2 connections.
Install CPython 3.16.0a2 as a managed Python version, with updated pip, zlib and Expat bundled in the managed 3.11 through 3.15 builds.
Request a specific schema version from the workspace metadata command in preview, and get aliased vulnerability records reported as one entry in audit output.
Install newer CPython builds (3.11.18, 3.12.16, 3.13.18, 3.14.10, 3.15.2) and detect NVIDIA GPU capabilities when selecting wheel variants in preview.
releases.breaking: The preview uv workspace metadata command now nests each module's owners inside an object, so scripts parsing its output need updating.

releases.new: Install the latest managed CPython 3.15.1, 3.14.9 and 3.13.17 security releases, which ship with pip 26.2.2 and an updated certificate bundle.
releases.breaking: Invalid custom build cache keys are now rejected instead of silently falling back to defaults, so fix any malformed cache key settings; uv no longer publishes Docker images for Python 3.9 and 3.10.
